_prototype_verification: PROTOTYPE stub. Numbers reflect a simplified subset of the federal Work Opportunity Tax Credit ('WOTC-lite'); the real WOTC has per-target-group caps and certification workflow this stub omits. Verify against IRS Form 5884 + DOL ETA guidance before any client use.

credit.name: Federal Work Opportunity Tax Credit (lite)
credit.summary: Per-employee federal credit for hires from targeted groups (veterans, long-term unemployed, SNAP recipients, etc.). This stub estimates a flat per-new-hire amount; production must layer target-group rates and hour thresholds.

filing.window: DOL ETA Form 9061/9062 within 28 days of hire

benefit._target_group_rate_note: ILLUSTRATIVE modeling assumption. WOTC applies only to hires certified in a target group (qualified veterans, SNAP recipients, long-term unemployed, designated-community residents, ex-felons, etc.). National certification rates run ~15-25% of new hires; logistics/warehouse skews higher. Production MUST screen each hire via DOL ETA Form 9061/9062 within 28 days — this rate is a portfolio-level estimate, not a per-employee determination.
benefit._note: Conservative flat estimate; real WOTC ranges $1,200-$9,600 by target group + hours.

one_zero._doc_source: Approximation patched in via rules/_patch_one_zero.py; verify against state DOR before client use.
one_zero._note: Federal WOTC (simplified): per-hire amount once 400-hour threshold cleared; this prototype uses a weekly-floor proxy. Each employer (FEIN) files its own WOTC, so entity_combination is 'prohibited'. Production needs DOL ETA 9061/9062 pre-screening, out of scope.
